items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: so I heard him and taken him right after we opened.

ctx.x: I replaced -- taken a new trombone player, because the other trombone player, he stayed in Turkey. He stayed in Turkey because he was in pretty bad health. And he stayed in Turkey.

And I came to Paris and I had taken a French trombone player. We had lost the guitarist. /He had said he didn't care to go to Germany, so I had taken another guitar player, which I changed right in Berlin, because there was an American boy in Los Angeles, Dickstein was the name. He was in Berlin.
